title: Spyglass: Officially Launched and Enhanced
summary: After a successful beta period, Spyglass is now officially launched and available to all users, delivering a more refined experience and powerful new capabilities.

title: Enhanced File Management and Display
summary: Our new, intuitive file management system empowers you to easily upload, remove, download, and precisely control how your images and documents appear within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: We've rolled out a brand-new public roadmap page, offering a transparent look at our latest achievements, what's next, and exciting future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes for Effortless Task Management
summary: Enjoy a beautifully redesigned experience with checkboxes that are now easier to click, visually consistent, and effortlessly draggable, making your task management smoother than ever.

title: Seamless Collaboration Experience
summary: Experience effortless teamwork in our editor with new features designed to make real-time collaboration more visible and intuitive for everyone.

title: Enhanced Shared Item Discovery & Collaboration
summary: We've made it easier to discover and collaborate on shared items, ensuring all relevant content you have access to is readily available in your search results for a more connected experience.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out comprehensive support for international languages, making our platform accessible to a global audience.

title: Noeko: Now Open Source for Ultimate Control
summary: We're excited to announce that Noeko is now open source, empowering you with greater control and a direct voice in its future development.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Constellation
summary: Transform your Constellation view into a dynamic exploration tool by introducing powerful new filters for tags, time windows, and shared items, making it easier than ever to navigate and discover connections within your knowledge base.

title: Powerful Search & Personalized Knowledge Views
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint and preserve specific sets of information by applying advanced filters, custom sorts, and saving your personalized knowledge views for instant access.

title: Interactive Content Overviews
summary: Unlock new ways to view and interact with your linked content, empowering you to structure your notes more intuitively and access information effortlessly.

title: Noeko: Self-Hosting & Flexible Paid Plans
summary: Get ready for Noeko's official public release, featuring powerful self-hosting options and flexible paid plans designed to give you complete control over your data and experience.

title: Enhanced & Expanded Theme Collection
summary: Transform your experience with a vibrant collection of new themes and beautifully polished classics, offering a personalized and visually appealing workspace.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: Experience perfectly timed greetings on your homepage that genuinely reflect the time of day, making your interaction more seamless and personal.

title: Effortless Tag Organization
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged items by removing them directly from any tag view, saving you valuable time and clicks.

title: Expand Your Knowledge Base with Diverse Content Sources
summary: Seamlessly integrate and interact with a wider array of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, to enrich your learning and research within the platform.
